description: Source code for handling admission responses in Kubernetes pod security admission, including functions for creating allowed, forbidden, invalid, and error responses, and initializing shared response variables with audit annotations.

methods.name: allowedResponse
methods.description: Creates and returns an AdmissionResponse indicating the request is allowed.

methods.name: forbiddenResponse
methods.description: Creates and returns an AdmissionResponse indicating the request is denied due to policy violations.

methods.name: invalidResponse
methods.description: Creates and returns an AdmissionResponse indicating invalid namespace labels.

methods.name: errorResponse
methods.description: Creates and returns an AdmissionResponse for generic errors, including error details in audit annotations.
